prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected outcomes.
Evidence is still too thin to establish rules for specific kinds of changes, as no change type has been tested at least twice.
No kind of change has been proven helpful yet, as no test has yielded a statistically significant win.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -3.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Stage Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen using a stage layout with clear path choice cards and playful visual styling. (why: Drop-off at choose_path is 23.8% with a long mean duration of 514s, showing users get stuck choosing how to start.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Trait Setup Screen: Add a new personality trait screen before home intro where users select key behaviors for their pet. (why: Overall finish rate is low (17.8%); giving users custom control over pet behavior right before finishing increases attachment and completion.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign In After Adoption Prep: Move the sign_in screen after pet customization screens (pick_friend and upload_photos) right before adoption confirmation. (why: 27.1% drop off at sign_in early in the flow; deferring account creation allows users to build an emotional connection to their pet first.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Naming Sub Flow: Insert a dedicated naming screen within the adoption flow to let users formally name their pet. (why: Adoption has a 39.1% dropoff rate and median 89s / mean 1017s time; explicit naming steps build clear structure.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Timer and Status: Enable progress visualizer and estimated time indicator on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting screen has a high mean duration of 2336s and 18.7% dropoff because users lack feedback on loading status.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Notification Toggle on Waiting Screen: Add a notification alert option so users get notified when pet setup finishes if they minimize the app. (why: Mean waiting duration is over 38 minutes (2336s), showing users minimize or leave the screen while waiting.)
6: [finish, hint] Pet Controls Keybinding Banner: Add a hint banner displaying keyboard shortcuts for summoning, controlling, or hiding the pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion post-onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Step Counter Header on Path Selection: Display step progress counter at the top of choose_path screen to anchor user expectations. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%; setting clear expectations upfront reduces early abandonment.)

scores.note: Choose path drops 23.8% with high mean time, but past redesign test showed -1.4% lift and costs a full screen update.
Finish step has 35.2% drop-off, but adding a new_screen previously yielded -3.9% lift on finish.
Sign-in drop-off is 27.1%, but reorder changes previously produced a -6.2% result on sign_in.
Adoption has high drop-off (39.1%) and long duration; new_flow is the only change type with positive past results (+1.9%).
Home wait time is 2336s with 18.7% drop-off; clear waiting status addresses user abandonment directly.
Addresses extreme mean duration (2336s) at home step by allowing users to background the app safely.
Strong evidence backed by both finish drop-off and 3 support tickets; cheap banner update.
Low cost config update to set expectations early, though targeted step drop-off is moderate (23.8%).
